name: Vega
best_known_for: Europe's small launcher: 22 flights from French Guiana between 2012 and 2024, 20 of them successful
credit: Vega: 22 flights, 20 successes, 2 failures (VV15, VV17); first flight 2012-02-13, last 2024-09-05 (Sentinel-2C). Sources: ESA Vega page (first flight, 22 flights, 20 successes, 30 m, 3 m, 137 t, stages P80 / Zefiro 23 / Zefiro 9 / AVUM) and the Wikipedia Vega article. Source conflict on payload: ESA gives about 1,500 kg to a 700 km circular 90-degree orbit, Wikipedia 1,450 kg to a 400 km sun-synchronous orbit; the ESA figure is used. Country 'Italy' is the lead nation of the programme and is not stated on the opened ESA or Avio pages (Wikipedia: developed by Avio). The VV15 (2019-07-11, FalconEye-1, Zefiro 23 forward dome) and VV17 (2020-11-17, SEOSAT-Ingenio and TARANIS) failure details come from search results and Wikipedia; the ESA inquiry pages were not fetched, only the dates were confirmed against the Wikipedia Vega summary. Checked 2026-11-25.
